title: BHIC Bofors Asia
description:
BHIC Bofors Asia Sdn Bhd (BBA) is a joint venture defense company based in Malaysia that provides maintenance, 
spare parts, and training support for Bofors naval weapon systems (such as the Bofors 40mm guns) 
used by the Royal Malaysian Navy and in the Asia-Pacific region.

Ownership: A joint venture between BHIC Defence Technologies Sdn Bhd (a subsidiary of Boustead Heavy Industries Corporation Bhd) 
and BAE Systems Bofors Holdings Sdn Bhd (Sweden/U.S. defense interests).

Total leak: 100GB High confidential data 

Data: NDA, Government contracts, Contracts with suppliers and clients, Vendor Pricelist Comparison, service reports, personal data, scans, drawings.
